projection.name: clickhouse
projection.title: ClickHouse
projection.description: ClickHouse cockpit with databases, tables, views, dictionaries, mutations, merges, processes, users, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable database password. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Reusable client certificate and private key used for certificate authentication.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for mTLS when password authentication is used.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, ALTER, DELETE, DDL, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE, SYSTEM, KILL, GRANT, and other write or operational statements.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before writes, DDL, mutations, OPTIMIZE, SYSTEM, KILL, and privileged statements execute.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this database? Every table, view, and dictionary it contains is permanently deleted.

fields.label: Target database
fields.help: Leave blank to keep the current database.

actions.label: Modify column
actions.confirmText: Modify this column? Changing its type rewrites the affected data via a mutation.

actions.label: Drop column
actions.confirmText: Drop this column? Its data is permanently removed.

fields.label: Expression
fields.help: Column or expression to index, e.g. `value` or `lower(name)`.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: Index type, e.g. minmax, set(0), bloom_filter(0.01), ngrambf_v1(...).

fields.label: CHECK expression
fields.help: Boolean expression every row must satisfy, e.g. `age >= 0`.

actions.label: Truncate
actions.confirmText: Truncate this table? Every row will be deleted.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this table? The table definition and data will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Kill query
actions.confirmText: Kill this running query? It is terminated on the server.

actions.label: Kill mutation
actions.confirmText: Kill this mutation? Cancelling a partially applied mutation can leave parts in a mixed state.

actions.label: Stop merges
actions.confirmText: Stop background merges for this table? Parts stop merging until merges are started again.

actions.label: Grant privilege
actions.confirmText: Grant privileges to this user? This can expand access to databases, tables, or cluster-level operations.

fields.label: Privilege
fields.help: Access type to grant, e.g. SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, or ALL.

actions.label: Drop user
actions.confirmText: Drop this user? They can no longer connect.
